improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly communicating the value proposition (Claude-powered, trade/business focus, free trial, low entry price). Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, and Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. Without these, search engines auto-generate poor snippets and social shares display generic or broken previews, hurting credibility and conversions.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Meet Gideon — get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try 3 free searches today."
improvements.rationale: This headline clearly positions Gideon as an AI assistant specifically for trade and business, immediately qualifying the target audience. The subheading reinforces key value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional support) while making the free trial offer prominent and friction-free. The word 'Meet' personalizes the AI brand name, and '3 free searches today' creates a low-commitment entry point that drives trial conversions.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've completed your three free searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member to continue accessing unlimited AI-powered trade and business support. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, billed monthly—or save 30 percent with an annual plan. As a member, you'll unlock voice chat, an unlimited workspace, and professional assistance whenever you need it.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the paywall moment—the critical conversion point where free users decide whether to subscribe. By clearly explaining what happens next and immediately reinforcing the low entry price and value (unlimited access, voice chat, workspace), it reduces friction and uncertainty, helping convert trial users into paying members.
